_comment: Frame order, layout and caption copy for the Play phone screenshots.
tools/store-shots.py captures the raw screens per storefront into build/store-raw/android/<locale>/;
tools/store-frames.mjs composes the finished, captioned set into store/android/<locale>/screenshots/.
Eight frames, Play's maximum, ordered by what decides an install: Play shows the first two or three
in search results. Frame 1 has to say 'password manager' in under a second, frame 2 shows everything it holds, and frame 3 is the one
feature no competitor has. Chosen in the 2026-10-22 gauntlet review; 'everything' moved from 8th to 2nd on the principal's call the same day.
Caption budget: two lines, 30 characters per line in English, so German has room. The word in
[brackets] is drawn in the accent colour; the brackets are not rendered.
Claims checked against the app: 'No server' rather than 'No cloud', because Backup & export
offers Android cloud backup. 'Recovery phrase' is the app's own term, not 'seed phrase'. The
invisible-entries caption does not say 'from anyone': the phrase reveals them for a session.
Every frame is the app's own pixels, cropped and labelled, never composited into a screen the app
does not have. 04 once floated the ID photo over the identity entry; the app shows it only in the
file viewer after a credential check, so it is now those two real screens (2026-10-22).
